snippet.title: Barkour - Official New Demo Trailer | The MIX | Kinda Funny Spring Game Showcase
snippet.description: Barkour is a fast-paced stealth-action platformer where you play as Agent T.H.U.N.D.E.R. - a tail-wagging canine with a knack for parkour, gadgets and barking at villains. Join a secret organization to stop evil schemes in a world full of charming absurdity. Barkour will be available on PC, and a new demo is out now on Steam.
